summary.headline: the budget-1 tightening node cannot certify for any ball at any rho' < R_j: the measure LP is trivially tight (tau == 1 == budget whenever ANY live placement exists), and the only other kill route -- an exactly empty live set -- fails because ball j's own ball is 100%% live (no placement in it meets a neighbour core).
summary.lemma: budget = 11 - 10 = 1.  If Q0 is any admissible placement that is not exempt, then mu(total) >= mu(Q0) >= 1 = budget, so tau >= budget identically.  Hence at budget 1 "tau < budget" <=> the live set is EMPTY, and the LP contributes nothing beyond exact coverage.

Collision-based emptiness is unreachable by any core quality.
